concepts.def: Linking personal troubles to public issues and social structure (C. Wright Mills 1959).
Patterned relationships and institutions (family, education, state) shaping individual behaviour.
Capacity of individuals to act independently and make choices; in tension with structural constraints.
Auguste Comte coined sociology 1838; advocated scientific study of society modelled on natural sciences.
Max Weber's interpretive understanding of social action from actor's viewpoint (1922).
External, coercive, general phenomena; Suicide (1897) used statistics to identify social causes.
